name: sidebar
purpose: Helps users move between views or sections. Composable application sidebar with optional header and footer regions; navigation content scrolls inside a built-in `ScrollArea`. It also owns **the rail gesture** — sizing the sidebar by dragging its trailing edge, and collapsing it out of the layout entirely. That belongs here rather than in each shell: the interaction is not a small one (a pointer drag that crosses the collapse boundary continuously, a keyboard equivalent, token-derived bounds, a phase-aware transition, and an affordance that brings a collapsed rail back), and every app that has a sidebar wants the same one. Two shells re-implementing it is how the two drift apart. Both halves are **opt-in and independent**: `resizable` adds the drag, `collapsible` adds the collapse trigger and the edge affordance. `collapsible="icon"` collapses to an **icon rail** instead of leaving the layout, and `shortcut` adds the Ctrl+B / Cmd+B toggle. With neither set the component renders exactly as it always has, with the host owning the width — every existing consumer is unaffected.
useWhen: Use Sidebar only when not using ConsoleLayout, which already renders the rail; put a SidebarMenu inside it.
The persistent navigation column of an app shell, with an optional header (brand, workspace switcher) and footer (profile, settings) around a scrolling `SidebarMenu`.
The user should be able to resize the rail by dragging its trailing edge (`resizable`) or take it out of the layout and bring it back (`collapsible`).
Wide work surfaces where the navigation should shrink to its icons rather than disappear (`collapsible="icon"`), so a destination stays one click away.
The rail's size or collapsed state must survive navigation or reloads — bind `v-model:width` and `v-model:open` and persist them in the app.
avoidWhen: Adjacent work areas the reader resizes (editor beside a preview, a terminal under it) → use `resizable`.
Horizontal top-level navigation with dropdown panels → use `navigation-menu`.
A temporary panel that slides over the page → use `drawer`.
related: `sidebar-menu` — the navigation rows, groups and drill levels that go in the sidebar's default slot.
`resizable` — draggable splits between content regions; the sidebar's rail gesture is for navigation only.
`app-header` — the top bar that usually sits above the sidebar in an app shell.
`console-layout` — the console layout template that composes the header, the sidebar and the page.
bestPractices: Put a `SidebarMenu` with `role="presentation"` in the default slot; the sidebar already renders the `nav` landmark and its `aria-label` (default `'Sidebar'`) names the region.
Group the rows with `SidebarMenu.Group`; the sidebar has no group part of its own.
Without `resizable` or `collapsible`, size the rail with a width class on the root; with either set, the sidebar owns the width and clamps it between `min-width-token` and `max-width-token`.
When the sidebar is revealed after mount (for example leaving a mobile layout where it was hidden), call the exposed `measure()` so the rail does not keep a zero width.
Keep the profile block in the `footer` slot; with `collapsible`, the collapse trigger renders in the same footer row.

With `collapsible="icon"`, give every top-level `SidebarMenu.Item` and drill `SidebarMenu.SubTrigger` an icon: rows without one (and inline sub-menus) step aside in the rail. Use the `{ rail }` slot scope to compact header and footer content (an avatar without the name).
Turn on `shortcut` for one sidebar per page only; Ctrl+B / Cmd+B is a page-wide key.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the navigation landmark. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Sidebar`).

props.name: resizable
props.doc: Adds the drag handle on the trailing edge; dragging past the minimum collapses the rail.

props.name: collapsible
props.doc: Adds the collapse trigger; `true` or `'offcanvas'` takes a collapsed sidebar out of the layout (with the edge affordance that brings it back), `'icon'` keeps an icon rail.

props.name: shortcut
props.doc: Lets Ctrl+B / Cmd+B toggle `open` while the sidebar is collapsible. Ignored while focus is in an editable field.

props.name: minWidthToken
props.doc: Theme container token the sized width is clamped up to, read off the document at runtime.

props.name: maxWidthToken
props.doc: Theme container token the sized width is clamped down to, read off the document at runtime.

props.name: collapseAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the collapse trigger. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Collapse sidebar`).

props.name: expandAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the control and the grab bar that bring a collapsed rail back. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Expand sidebar`).

props.name: resizeAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name for the drag handle separator. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Resize sidebar`).

slots.name: default
slots.notes: The navigation. `rail` is true while the sidebar is collapsed to its icon rail.

slots.name: header
slots.notes: Named slot. Use `rail` to compact the content in the icon rail.

slots.name: footer
slots.notes: Named slot. The collapse trigger renders after this content in the same row, under one full-width separator, so a profile block and the trigger read as one footer. In the icon rail the row stacks and the trigger becomes the expand button.
